id: # Runtime voice: the close approach of a calm docking (30 m and closing slower than the tense speed). A kerbal says a line alone over the radio
# (event chat on=dockclose), with a link to Mission Control it answers with a line of kind dock_close. A fast, tense approach plays the recorded dock_close scenes instead.
# The format is explained at the top of reports.tsv.

spanish: A {dist_m} metros. Vamos despacio. | {dist_m} metros. Todo bajo control.
english: {dist_m} meters. Nice and slow. | {dist_m} meters. All under control.

spanish: Puerto a la vista. Alineando. | Casi en el puerto. Alineando.
english: Port in sight. Aligning. | Nearly at the port. Aligning.

spanish: Ya casi. Pulso firme. | Despacio, despacio.
english: Almost there. Steady hands. | Slowly, slowly.

spanish: Cerca de {target}. Todo en orden. | {target} justo delante.
english: Close to {target}. All in order. | {target} dead ahead.

spanish: Velocidad baja, puertos alineados. | Cerca. Muy cerca.
english: Low speed, ports aligned. | Close. Very close.

spanish: Os vemos bien. Seguid así. | Buena aproximación. Seguid así.
english: Looking good. Keep it up. | Good approach. Keep it up.

spanish: {target} a {dist_m} metros. Con calma. | Vais bien hacia {target}. Con calma.
english: {target} at {dist_m} meters. Take it easy. | You're on course for {target}. Take it easy.

spanish: Alineación correcta. Sin prisas. | Vuestra alineación es buena. Sin prisas.
english: Alignment is good. No hurry. | Your alignment is good. No hurry.

spanish: Velocidad perfecta. Así se hace. | Muy buena velocidad de acercamiento.
english: Perfect speed. That's how it's done. | Very good closing speed.

spanish: Os acercáis a {close_ms} metros por segundo. Perfecto. | {close_ms} metros por segundo. Justo lo que queremos.
english: You're closing at {close_ms} meters per second. Perfect. | {close_ms} meters per second. Just what we want.

spanish: Casi estáis. Despacio y sin sustos. | Ya casi. Sin sustos.
english: Almost there. Slow and no scares. | Almost there. No scares.

id: # Distance callouts at 30, 15 and 5 m (event chat on=dockcallout, dist_m is the distance of the callout).

spanish: {dist_m} metros. | Estamos a {dist_m} metros. | {dist_m} metros. Todo bien.
english: {dist_m} meters. | We're at {dist_m} meters. | {dist_m} meters. All good.

spanish: {dist_m} metros. Despacio. | Quedan {dist_m} metros.
english: {dist_m} meters. Slowly. | {dist_m} meters to go.

spanish: {dist_m} metros. Casi. | {dist_m} metros. Sin movimientos bruscos.
english: {dist_m} meters. Almost. | {dist_m} meters. No sudden moves.

spanish: Aproximación a {dist_m} metros. | {dist_m} metros del puerto.
english: Approach at {dist_m} meters. | {dist_m} meters from the port.

spanish: Faltan {dist_m} metros. | {dist_m} metros. Puertos casi alineados.
english: {dist_m} meters left. | {dist_m} meters. Ports almost aligned.

id: # Mission Control after a distance callout (kind dock_callout, dist_m is the distance of the callout). Also after the beeps of a probe.

spanish: Os vemos a {dist_m} metros. Todo bien. | Confirmado, {dist_m} metros. Seguid así.
english: We see you at {dist_m} meters. All good. | Confirmed, {dist_m} meters. Keep it up.

spanish: Copiado, {dist_m} metros. Con calma.
english: Copy, {dist_m} meters. Take it easy.

spanish: Copiado, {dist_m} metros. Despacio en el último tramo.
english: Copy, {dist_m} meters. Easy on the last stretch.

spanish: {dist_m} metros. La alineación se ve bien.
english: {dist_m} meters. Alignment looks good.

spanish: {dist_m} metros. Ya casi. Suave.
english: {dist_m} meters. Almost there. Gently.

spanish: {dist_m} metros. Contacto inminente. Suave.
english: {dist_m} meters. Contact soon. Gently.

id: # Far callouts at 500, 250 and 100 m (dist_m>=75), crew and Mission Control.

spanish: Objetivo a {dist_m} metros. Nos acercamos. | {dist_m} metros. Aproximación en marcha.
english: Target at {dist_m} meters. Closing in. | {dist_m} meters. Approach under way.

spanish: {target} a {dist_m} metros. | A {dist_m} metros de {target}.
english: {target} at {dist_m} meters. | {dist_m} meters from {target}.

spanish: {dist_m} metros. Preparando el atraque. | Todo listo para el atraque, {dist_m} metros.
english: {dist_m} meters. Preparing to dock. | All set for docking, {dist_m} meters.

spanish: Os seguimos a {dist_m} metros. Buena aproximación. | {dist_m} metros del objetivo. Todo en orden.
english: We follow you at {dist_m} meters. Good approach. | {dist_m} meters from the target. All in order.

spanish: Copiado, {dist_m} metros. Preparad el atraque.
english: Copy, {dist_m} meters. Prepare to dock.
